items.name: Ash-Shafted Training Spear
items.description: A balanced iron-tipped spear issued to Proving recruits. Can be honed with a Whetstone.

items.name: Honed Wayfarer Spear
items.description: A razor-honed spear gleaming from fresh whetstone work.

items.name: Coastal Yew Shortbow
items.description: A supple shortbow that fires cleanly past frontline guards to hit backline foes.

items.name: Trail Utility Dagger
items.description: A light steel blade suited for quick strikes and camp chores.

items.name: Carved Wayfarer Staff
items.description: An ashwood staff banded with brass runes that steadies arcane casting.

items.name: Warden's Proven Halberd
items.description: A ceremonial yet battle-ready polearm awarded to graduates who light the Proving Beacon.

items.name: Banded Oak Roundshield
items.description: A sturdy rimmed shield ideal for blocking blows in melee.

items.name: Quilted Proving Jerkin
items.description: Tough stitched canvas and boiled leather worn by courtyard initiates.

items.name: Sea-Mist Ranger Cloak
items.description: A hooded olive-slate mantle that breaks up a scout's silhouette.

items.name: Lantern-Stitch Mantle
items.description: Layered woolen vestments threaded with conductive copper wire.

items.name: Watchman's Kettle Helm
items.description: A wide-brimmed steel helm recovered from the Watchtower Ruins.

items.name: Hobnailed Coast Boots
items.description: Grippy leather boots built for slick cliff stones and pine roots.

items.name: Initiate's Brass Focus Band
items.description: A warm hammered brass ring etched with a tiny compass star.

items.name: Emerald Wayfarer Amulet
items.description: A sea-green rune shard set in brass that bolsters vitality and focus.

items.name: Signet of the First Warden
items.description: A gleaming bronze-and-emerald signet hidden decades ago for observant recruits.

items.name: Hardtack & Smoked Cheese
items.description: Simple trail food that staves off hunger and restores modest stamina.

items.name: Sunleaf Healing Salve
items.description: A soothing herbal balm that rapidly knits cuts and bruises.

items.name: Ember-Spiced Vigor Tonic
items.description: A fiery draught that restores stamina and sharpens combat readiness.

items.name: Draught of Clear Horizons
items.description: A crystal-bright restorative brewed by skilled herbalists.

items.name: Wayfarer Smithing Toolkit
items.description: Tongs, hammer, and file for forging metal and timber gear at the Ember Forge.

items.name: Herbalist Field Mortar
items.description: A compact stone mortar and glass phials for brewing salves and tonics.

items.name: Lantern-Wright Calipers
items.description: Fine brass tools for setting rune shards into jewelry and lanterns.

items.name: Coastal River Whetstone
items.description: A fine-grained honing stone. Combine with your Training Spear in Inventory to upgrade it.

items.name: Roll of Steel Lockpicks
items.description: Tension wrench and hooks required for picking locked chests and doors.

items.name: Brass Proving Lantern
items.description: A wind-proof lantern that cuts through sea mist and dim ruins.

items.name: Watchtower Bronze Crest
items.description: A stamped bronze crest proving you mastered the Rune Archway in the Old Watchtower Ruins.

items.name: Consecrated Beacon Flint
items.description: A rune-etched striker stone used to ignite the Wayfarer Beacon on the southern cliff.

items.name: Sealed Wayfarer Charter
items.description: Warden Halrik's waxed seal certifying that you have completed every trial of the Proving Isle.
